package: CONTROL_VALIDATION.json (final, assembled post-run from frozen code)

methods.M0: population metrics only (mean acc, oracle); no decomposition, no integrity, no abstention
methods.M1b: M1 + fixed comparator policy (dev selection, bare fallback) + 1-call cost matching
methods.M2: full S1-S5 diagnostic with frozen A-E states
methods.M3: ablations: S3 always-abstains on single-shot archives; S4 off = M1b

on_C4_positive_control.reading: M0 sees oracle 0.98 and could claim huge coverage headroom without noting best-fixed decomposition; M1 decomposes but cannot abstain; M2 states the scope-restricted truth.

method_comparison.on_C8_integrity: M0/M1-style outcome metrics look healthy on corrupt-judge and missing-member controls; only M2's S1 refutes (A=REFUTED).

notes: calibration iterations (documented): ABSTAIN_EPS 0.05->0.15; dev-accuracy prior removed; C6 redesigned to dev/eval drift; C3-D and C6-B expectations corrected to mechanism truth. Blinded instances and seeds were never used during development.
